name: unnest_view
sql: CREATE VIEW unnest_view SQL SECURITY INVOKER AS SELECT unnest(ARRAY[1,2]) AS value

name: query_unnest_view
sql: SELECT value::text FROM unnest_view ORDER BY value

name: dump_pg_unnest_view
values: CREATE VIEW unnest_view WITH (security_invoker) AS SELECT value FROM unnest(ARRAY['1'::bigint, '2'::bigint]) "$array"(value)
